tasks.title: Tour band, entry points and keyboard
tasks.description: A #tour band pinned inside header.top on every stage, a Take the tour button, Start the tour links on the landing cards, the target outline, and ← → / Esc while the tour is active.
tasks.details:
Shells: add <section id="tour" hidden> inside header.top in basic, intermediate and advanced, and a Take the tour button in the masthead. Landing: a Start the tour link on each stage card (relative URL, ?tour=1). DOM layer (shared/tour-band.js or in tour.js behind a separate export): render the kicker TOUR · <STAGE> · N OF M, the title, Look at / What you see / Why it matters, Proves as reasonChip buttons (the glossary opens on click), and Back, Next ("Next: step 3 →") and Leave. On each stop it calls the page adapter { select(at), apply(set), after render } and then outlines the target (.tour-target) with an instant scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }). While the tour is active, ← → move stops (the page step keys yield) and Esc leaves. style.css: a note callout (accent border on accent-soft), a .tour-target outline from the accent token, talk-mode sizes, a 1024 px wrap rule in the trailing @media block. No transitions, shadows or new colour meaning; chrome.js must re-measure --top-h when the band opens or closes. Basic page wiring only; intermediate and advanced wire their adapters in their own tags.
